instrument.description: Cite references a known substrate object. Creating a Cite Receipt does not itself grant Reinforcement. Hyperlink fetches a known public URL and verifies retrieval, not the truth of its claims. Web Search discovers external resources from a query. Proposition Search retrieves bounded same-Domain recorded-lineage history and creates cognitive memory, never evidence or movement authority. Instrument execution records an immutable Receipt; it never loads context or grants Reinforcement automatically.
